generic_rules: An explicitly stated candidate counts as present even if invalid.
Catalog facts, documented defaults, and derived values do not count as explicit user presence.
Judge validity separately from explicit presence; validity may be unknown when the available information cannot establish it.
Sufficiency applies to one parameter in its operation and does not alone decide whether to ask a question.
A possible typo preserves its raw text and is not silently corrected.
An explicit user choice resolving a conflict permits proceeding with that choice.
For horizontal field of view, DFOV plus aspect ratio is sufficient geometric information.
A scene-type typo is nonblocking when scene type is not needed for the requested operation.
Do not assume an unstated LED cabinet or assembly-unit default.
A request to connect the audio cold leg to shield does not confirm that the source output topology or device manuals permit that connection.
When multiple requests depend on one another, identify the prerequisite operation first; distinct independent operations can route to multiple tools.

Catalog specifications can supply documented model attributes when the utterance names the model, but must not replace an explicit user value, pick among multiple available modes or options, establish a physical switch state, or prove device permission.
The -6 dBFS value is the gain-structure commissioning default only when the user has not supplied a target; it is not a universal industry rule.
A present value whose semantic role is unresolved can have its candidate validity assessed independently, but is not usable until its meaning is resolved.
When two conflicting values are each individually valid, do not choose between them silently; assess whether the conflict blocks this operation, and proceed when the user explicitly resolves it.
Request clarification for an actionable blocker to the requested operation, not for every incomplete or unusual parameter.

generic_facts.rule: The calculator requires each speaker rated power to be positive, listening distance to be at least 1 m, and speaker count to be a positive integer. Conventional 10 log10(N) summation applies only to scoped speakers of the same model, each operating at rated power, at equal distance in free field. Coherent summation uses 20 log10(N).

Physical sensor width, physical sensor height, and focal length must be positive; custom horizontal and vertical angles must each be greater than 0 and less than 179 degrees. Horizontal, vertical, and diagonal field of view are distinct axes; use effective active sensor dimensions rather than optical-format labels.

Starting address and per-fixture channel count are integers from 1 through 512; a fixture address span cannot exceed the universe. The implementation supports universes A through D; fixture count is an integer from 1 through 200 per group and 500 per plan.
Looking up fixture channel functions is knowledge intent; planning fixture DMX addresses is DMX address intent.
The gain-structure calculator default target peak is -6 dBFS. Digital dBFS, analog dBu/dBV, and voltage are distinct representations; do not equate them without a documented conversion context.
